name: What kind of maintenance does a new custom shower require?

mainEntity.name: What kind of maintenance does a new custom shower require?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintaining a new custom shower typically involves regular cleaning of tiles, grout, and glass enclosures to prevent soap scum and mildew buildup. The specific cleaning routine will depend on the materials chosen; for instance, natural stone may require different care than porcelain or ceramic tiles. Choosing high-quality, durable materials from the outset, a hallmark of AKN Design Group's projects, can simplify long-term maintenance. We provide guidance on appropriate care for your specific selections, ensuring your spa-inspired shower retains its beauty and functionality for years.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintenance involves regular cleaning of tiles, grout, and glass. High-quality materials can simplify this, with specific care depending on material type.
